311:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚクリスタル$$, a crystallization of $$Ｚチップ$$s, reacts to people's feelings and wishes.」

311:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It was picking up all sorts of feelings overflowing from $$ジェニオン$$, too.」

311:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$'s private lessons, set on an isolated island in the middle of the sea...」

311:t_10:34.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You... seem to want to die, don't you?」

311:t_10:36.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Fine. Crushing you would make things troublesome later.」

311:t_10:38.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't make me angry, $$ＡＧ$$. You know what will happen if you do, don't you?」

311:t_10:40.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're a good boy. Restrain yourself from now on.」

311:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...No... In that state just now, there's no need to call her 'Miss.'」

311:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I never thought the plan I'd nearly given up on would come back to life now... I have $n to thank for this, too.)

311:t_10:44.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So I'm going to work hard, too! Even when the future's uncertain... business, business!」

312:t_000:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「What's the situation on $$メリダ島$$...!?」

312:t_000:1.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The garrison has been wiped out. All facilities have been captured, too.」

312:t_000:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The last information to reach Operations indicates that $$ミスリル$$ bases elsewhere, including Intelligence, were also attacked and apparently destroyed.」

312:t_000:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$アマルガム$$... I never imagined they'd prepared such a huge force...)

312:t_000:4.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「We had as many $$メリダ島$$ staff as possible evacuate or come aboard this vessel.」

312:t_000:5.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「But we haven't confirmed Major $$カリーニン$$'s whereabouts.」

312:t_000:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Now that we don't even know $c's situation, we must get through this crisis on our own.」

312:t_000:8.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「There is no problem.」

312:t_000:9.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, ruler of the seven seas and the vast sea of space, proudly the strongest vessel in human history, has already set sail.」

312:t_000:10.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Please give your orders. The entire crew awaits your words, Captain.」

312:t_001:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「That giant has appeared in our path!」

312:t_002:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Fire all ADCAPs, one through six! Then full speed ahead!」

312:t_003:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「I've confirmed the enemy AS is still operational!」

312:t_003:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye aye, ma'am! I'll follow you even into hell!」

312:t_004:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「I've confirmed the enemy AS has been destroyed.」

312:t_004:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Emergency dive! We'll break through the enemy encirclement!」

312:t_004:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$相良$$, $$カナメ$$... Everyone in $c... For now, all I can do is pray you're safe...)
